newsitem.title: CHINA: Deng funeral committee thanks all for condolences.
newsitem.headline: Deng funeral committee thanks all for condolences.

text.p: The funeral committee established to handle the last rites of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping on Wednesday thanked people around the world who had sent messages of condolence in the aftermath of his death last Wednesday.
The official Xinhua news agency quoted a statement from the committee as saying that the Chinese leadership was determined to keep to the policies and wishes of Deng.

The statement said many political leaders and friends in all parts of the world had sent messages of condolence and participated in mourning activities to express their grief at Deng's death. "We wish to express our sincere thanks," the statement said.

The leadership will "hold high Deng Xiaoping's great banner of building socialism with Chinese characteristics, adhere unwaveringly to the (Communist) Party's basic line and hold to an independent and peaceful foreign policy," it said.
It called on people to "draw strength from grief", and to fight to make China into a "prosperous, democratic and civilised socialist state."
The statement, in effect, marked the conclusion of the mourning period for Deng Xiaoping, whose funeral was held on Tuesday.
